This is the personal portfolio of Barathwaj Maadhavan. It contains detailed case studies of AI and automation projects, information on leadership initiatives, and a blog.

- [Leadership & Training](https://barathwajmaadhavan.com/#leadership): Information on employee wellness and GenAI upskilling initiatives.
- [Awards](https://barathwajmaadhavan.com/awards.html): Professional recognitions.
